{{Quote|This is Her Imperial Majesty's Star Destroyer ''Animus''... ...Prepare for emergency docking procedures.|Animus' commander to Ania Solo's ship|<ref name="Legacy (2013) 6">[[Legacy (2013) 6|''Legacy'' (2013) 6]]</ref>}}
The '''''Animus''''' was a [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] utilized by the [[Fel Empire]] in [[138 ABY]]. Because of the formation of the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]], it also saw usage in the Triumvirate as well.

After [[Ania Solo]] and her crew sent a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]] after their [[AG-37's freighter|ship]] ended up damaged while pursuing [[Darth Wredd]], the ''Animus'', having picked up their signal, prepared emergency boarding for the vessel, with one of Solo's crewmates, [[Sauk]], pondering whether this was a good thing. Afterwards, a [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Animus)|female officer]] welcomed Solo aboard the ''Animus'', also noting that it was rare for civilians to appear on a Star Destroyer, especially civilians from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], with her also relaying that Empress [[Marasiah Fel]] was impressed in Solo's role in [[Carreras Incident|saving]] the Imperial Knight Yalta Val from the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]] and requested Solo's presence in front of a formal audience regarding the Triumvirate, to Solo's confusion.
